snippet.title: Chickens. Chickens? Chickens! Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Official release trailer for Chickens. Chickens? Chickens!

💰👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4673420/Chickens_Chickens_Chickens/ 🙏

🐓 Fight ridiculous chicken hordes in a fast, casual arena shooter. 🐓 Move, dodge, shoot, survive waves, chase a better score, and try not to get buried in feathers.
